shops.description: Supermarkets, convenience stores, department stores, malls

bus_stops.description: All bus stops (SITP and untagged) - broad query to capture all tagging variants
bus_stops.notes: Do NOT filter by network=SITP - misses ~60% of actual stops. Dedup nodes within 30m.

leisure.notes: Coverage too sparse and patchy. Three of five test neighborhoods returned zero. Not recommended.

within_osm.commerce: distance < 50m AND (name_similarity > 0.8 OR same type at exact coords)

osm_vs_ideca.commerce: No overlap - IDECA has no commerce data
osm_vs_ideca.bus_stops: Minimal overlap - IDECA has TransMilenio trunk stations only. Dedup by distance < 100m.
osm_vs_ideca.transmilenio: OSM has ~1 TM station vs IDECA 150. Keep IDECA as authoritative for TM.

bias_warnings.restaurants_cafes: HIGH bias - 38:1 ratio between wealthiest and poorest neighborhoods
bias_warnings.banks_pharmacies: MODERATE bias - 10:1 ratio, chain coverage helps
bias_warnings.supermarkets: LOW bias - Kennedy has more supermarkets than Chapinero
bias_warnings.bus_stops: MODERATE bias - Ciudad Bolivar has weak coverage (42 vs 358 in Chapinero)
